::: {.callout-warning}
## Under Correction: Offline Correction-Authority Margins

Simulation-only **correction-authority margins** from the offline LTV Gramian evaluator may be
wrong or optimistic until [#5566](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/5566)
(Gramian recursion) and [#5567](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/5567)
(peak-per-channel radius) are fixed and derived artifacts are regenerated on this branch.

Read the [correction-authority numerics corrections note (2026-11-10)](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/research/alpha-war-thesis/docs/development/correction-authority-numerics-corrections-2026-11-10.md)
(epic [#5565](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/5565)). Do not treat evaluator
margins, recoverable flags, or Option A comparison summaries as final evidence until then.
:::
